description: Look up a VA form number, such as 21-0966. Use form_name from search results, not the numeric catalog id. If form_name is missing, ask for the form number. Returns available title, revision details and official PDF link. The link does not complete or submit an application or establish eligibility.

id.description: Official form number (the form_name field in search results), such as 21-0966. Do not use the numeric catalog id.

name: get_va_form
